card.name: "be" after "dose selection should"
card.fires_on: The word "be" right after "dose selection ... should", especially in the geriatric-use sentence "dose selection for an elderly patient should be cautious". Weaker hits occur on a few other words in formal passages.

modes.label: Geriatric dose-selection sentence
modes.description: The word "be" after "dose selection for an elderly patient should".
modes.example: In general, dose selection for an elderly patient should<< be>> cautious, usually starting at the low end

modes.label: Dose selection in neuromuscular blockade
modes.description: The word "be" after "Dose selection should" in a block-recovery passage.
modes.example: Dose selection should<< be>> based on the extent of spontaneous recovery at
